question: Should Android Settings become a full skills-management surface, including ClawHub install and global enable/disable, with the new explicit `skills.securityVerdicts.items[]` request mode?
rationale: This is a new mobile admin surface plus an additive Gateway protocol shape; source review can verify mechanics, but product/API ownership should decide whether Android should own this workflow now.

options.title: Accept after proof and formatting
options.body: Keep the direction, require ktlint plus real Android-gateway proof, and then review the rebased branch for merge.

options.title: Narrow Android to read-only skills
options.body: Reject the install/toggle parts for now and keep Android limited to status/search until mobile admin UX is explicitly prioritized.

options.title: Defer the protocol extension
options.body: Hold or close the PR until maintainers settle the security-verdict request API outside this Android feature branch.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof and formatting
recommendation.body: Keep the direction, require ktlint plus real Android-gateway proof, and then review the rebased branch for merge.
